aliases: Students' role in competency based training
banglaExplanation: CBT-তে students শুধু শুনে না, নিজের শেখার দায়িত্ব নেয়।
নিজের rate-এ শেখে; দরকারে speed up, slow down বা repeat করে।
অন্য students-এর সাথে নয়, preset job standards-এর সাথে প্রতিযোগিতা।
শুরুতেই জানে কী জানতে ও করতে হবে, আর নিজের progress নিজে দেখে।

example.bn: রান্নার trainee তিনবার practice করে, ready হলে trainer-কে দক্ষতা দেখায়।
example.en: A cooking trainee repeats the bread task three times. He says he is ready, then shows mastery to the trainer.

short.modelAnswer:
In a CBT system, students:
1. select modules/UoC to learn, and when
2. learn at their own rate
3. request credit for what they already know
4. decide when they are ready to show mastery
5. compete against job standards, not other students
6. know up front what they must know and do
7. evaluate their own progress
8. move freely in the training area
9. are assessed mainly on performance
10. learn by their motivation, needs and abilities
